![](https://mail.google.com/mail/?attbid=ANGjdJ9suVkXtbtn00yy4zcXU21_dPe9hJA6km45L1YOo0PgqwoUt7-qdyY2NhD5po8DZuFnBFiqQFYi_vLgu9mTbnZaNw-qbhU7iAhrQZIXLUvMd2V5-xBWvIlkz1o&attid=0.1&disp=emb&fur=ip&ik=51d4f89ad9&rm=19493ac1fd7f8c2d&sz=w1600-h1000&th=19493ac1fd7f8c2d&ui=2&view=fimg&zw%2Fdownloaded=)

We are excited to announce a **special** **promotion** in honour of the **30th Anniversary of the JUNIOR II** from **Bauer**!

From **18** **January to 30 April 2025**, we will offer an exclusive **Anniversary Edition** with unique features to celebrate this milestone.

![](https://transilvaniacavediving.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image002-2.png)

The Anniversary Edition includes:

- 2 additional filter cartridges

- A 1-year warranty extension

- A commemorative “30 Years” sticker

- An informative brochure showcasing the history of the JUNIOR II.
